values.note: Operator's 2026 rates: RV sites with water and 30-amp $50, water and 50-amp $55, sewer, water and 30/50-amp $65 a night, for up to 4 people (additional person $5 ages 3-15, $10 ages 16+); holiday rates apply. Campspot charged the same $50-65 for October and November 2026 nights (read 2026-10-13); the park adds 3.5% of the site charge as a 'Credit Card Fee' and Campspot its own booking fee (3%, at least $3). Cancel 8+ days out for a refund less $25.
